headline: Zuari Management Services Limited submits SEBI Takeover Disclosure for Zuari Agro Chemicals
sum: Zuari Management Services Limited has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4), signalling a material shareholding event in Zuari Agro Chemicals Limited.
detail: SEBI Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure within 4 trading days of crossing prescribed shareholding thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, 90%). The filing by Zuari Management Services Limited signals a substantial acquisition of equity in Zuari Agro Chemicals Limited, a listed entity on the National Stock Exchange. The disclosure is foundational for triggering subsequent open offer obligations under Regulation 37 if the acquirer intends to gain control or if a 25% threshold is breached by a non-promoter.
